title: A little calm before the call.
action: The mint speech-bubble mascot floats at the center of a softly lit mint and forest-green space. Blurred frosted-glass appointment shapes frame it, suggesting an organized calendar. Hold briefly, then the incoming ring leads into the groomer.
audio: A soft, warm opening tone. The incoming phone ring starts just before the cut. No dialogue.

title: Hands full.
action: The groomer washes the Samoyed. The phone rings.

title: She can’t pick up.
action: Her hands stay with the dog.

title: Someone answers.
action: The little mascot pops up and speaks.
audio: “Hi, Happy Paws. How can I help?”

title: Milo needs a groom.
action: At home, the caller has a very unruly little companion.

title: A time that works.
action: The caller agrees while Milo makes himself the centre of attention.

title: Booked. Back to the dog.
action: She keeps working. The caller has her appointment.

title: A quick sweep into the salon.
action: A towel crosses the lens and reveals the next business.

title: Mid-blow-dry.
action: Brush in one hand, dryer in the other. The mascot answers.

title: A customer calls.
action: He wants to find a time for a haircut.

title: Friday works.
action: One clear offer, one simple yes.

title: Keep looking after the client.
action: The appointment is booked while the stylist finishes her work.

title: Follow the movement.
action: The camera sweeps past the mirror into a photography studio.

title: The family finally laughs.
action: The photographer has both hands on the camera.

title: The next family calls.
action: A caller asks about a Saturday session.

title: An easy yes.
action: The offered time suits her.

title: The moment is still his.
action: The photographer catches the laughter while the booking is handled.

title: Past the studio light.
action: The camera passes behind the softbox, hiding the cut.

title: Into the workshop.
action: We arrive beside a mechanic already occupied with a car.

title: Both hands on the job.
action: The mechanic checks the engine. The mascot takes the call.

title: This one needs a person.
action: The caller wants to move an existing appointment.

title: A clear handoff.
action: A callback is requested for the team. No false rescheduling confirmation.
audio: “I’ll ask the team to call you back.”

title: Stay with the customer.
action: A fresh moment with the groomer and the Samoyed.
audio: “Stay with the customer in front of you.”

title: Give the next one a way to reach you.
action: The stylist finishes with her client.
audio: “Give the next one a way to reach you.”

title: Meet your AI receptionist.
action: The mascot returns for a simple closing invitation.
